description: This file defines the SearchFormMetaParser class which extends MetaParser to parse search form metadata for a CRM system. It includes methods for parsing HTML content, merging sections, processing sections, applying rules, and handling search form layout configurations.

classes.name: SearchFormMetaParser
classes.description: A class to parse and process search form metadata for the CRM's search layout, extending the MetaParser base class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser, setting the view type to 'Search'.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a search form PHP file, extract and possibly merge layout sections, and generate a PHP code string representing the search definitions.

methods.name: mergeSection
methods.description: Merges a given section with a master section, replacing existing elements with master copy elements.

methods.name: processSection
methods.description: Processes a section of the search form HTML, extracting form fields from table rows and cells.

methods.name: applyRules
methods.description: Applies transformation rules to a search section, e.g., modifying email fields.
